source_message.text:
Hello Alex,
finally I've been able to check everything and review your drawings.

1\. Main difference, which I wasn't aware about is that we need to produce premachined parts, weld them together and then do the final machining. We are talking about POS 1+2+3.

2\. Main shaft raw input material is tube 108/28 and will be premachined in order to secure positions for POS 2+3.

3\. The bushing which was not clear is located inside the main shaft (**IMPORTANT**: in my notes, there is this information incorrect - the bushing is not mounted to the POS 4 but in main shaft only) - please choose suitable clearance to fit bushing and shaft.

4\. On POS 4 is mounted piston/rod end with nut. This rod from control piston (securing the sliding movement) is inside the main shaft (that's why the inner dia of 55mm must be also machined after welding).

5\. The cross section C-C on mainshaft drw. indicates this keyway will not be there, the request is to make the thread for locking nut M100x2 wider; also space for main bushing is requested wider (40mm)

6\. If possible, please use numbering of drawings as shown on assembly

Let me know the progress and thank you!

There are still a few unclear points regarding the bushing. As I understand it, the three holes are intended for fastening it with screws. However, at the same time, there appears to be a very large interference fit: the outer diameter of the bushing is 61.2 mm, while the bore in the mating part is 60 mm
